title: Sample: HTTP basics
description: Example deck showing the format agents should produce.

cards.back: Not Found — the server can't find the requested resource.
Unauthorized — authentication is required or failed.
Forbidden — authenticated (or not) but not allowed to access the resource.

GET, HEAD, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS, TRACE.
(POST and PATCH are not guaranteed idempotent.)

cards.front: What header tells the client the response body format?
What does the `Cache-Control: no-store` directive do?
cards.back: Tells caches not to store any part of the request or response.
